llm.opinion: High-confidence ransomware behavioral pattern detected. Correlated indicators map to MITRE ATT&CK techniques T1486, T1490. Primary signals: mass file rename burst, ransom note drop, and shadow-copy deletion attempt. ML model probability of ransomware activity: 0.9163. This combination is inconsistent with legitimate backup software, updater processes, or user activity. Recommended immediate actions: (1) isolate host from network, (2) terminate and quarantine the initiating process/account, (3) preserve memory and disk images, (4) validate offline backup integrity before any recovery steps. Escalate to incident response lead for authorization of containment actions.
